matches.rationale: The ground truth describes a global conceptual flaw—galaxies incorrectly treated as being in a different reference frame than the observer, invalidating the equations throughout. None of the findings identify this reference-frame assumption; instead they report specific algebraic/typographical inconsistencies between individual equations (Eq.4 vs Eq.5, Eq.30/31 Etherington relation, Eq.34 vs Eq.36), which are different, narrower defects not tied to the stated mechanism.

pred_verdicts.rationale: Identifies a genuine internal inconsistency in the Doppler/aberration equations, but this is a distinct algebraic error, not the reference-frame assumption described in the ground truth.
Points to an inconsistency in the Etherington relation derivation, unrelated to the ground truth's reference-frame mechanism.
Flags a mismatch between Eq.(34) and Eq.(36), a separate algebraic defect not matching the ground truth's described issue.
